# Class: PluginManager

Defined in: [src/ts/core/plugin/PluginManager.ts:22](https://github.com/getkist/kist/blob/f71ef15f65fa7d6bf20184980805f739271c031f/src/ts/core/plugin/PluginManager.ts#L22)

PluginManager handles discovery, loading, and lifecycle of kist plugins.
Supports both npm-installed plugins (@getkist/plugin-*) and local plugins.

- `AbstractProcess`
